The '''A5-series Assassin Droid''' was a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A reprogrammed unit, [[A5]], served as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] at the [[Farrimmer Cafe]].
